doc.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: They thank each other and agree on a signed CD and a copy of the video.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I want to thank you for your time today.
I hope you’ll sign my CD.
It will be a pleasure for me.
And next time I try to play “Quiet Now” I’ll be thinking of you.
I hope you’ll send me a copy of the video.
